## Problem

Forecast daily sales for 1,115 Rossmann stores 42 days ahead, supporting inventory and staffing decisions.

## Approach

Comparison between classical statistical models fitted per store and a single global machine learning model trained on all stores.

## Technologies

[Python]{.tag} [pandas]{.tag} [Time series]{.tag} [Machine Learning]{.tag}
